  if (calendarEventLooksLikeProgram(event)) return "program";   return "school"; }  function calendarEventMatchesFilter(event) {   if (calendarFilter === "all") return true;   if (calendarFilter === "pending") return calendarEventIsPending(event);   return calendarEventVisualKind(event) === calendarFilter; }  function calendarDisplayTitle(event) {   const title=String(event?.title||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();   const raw=String(event?.originalDetail||event?.detail||'').replace(/\r/g,'');   const parts=raw.split(/[\n/]+/).map(x=>x.replace(/^\([^)]*\)\s*/,'').trim()).filter(Boolean);   const looksGeneric = !title || /^(?:\(?\d+[-~]?\d*교시\)?|\(?\d+[-~]\d+교시\)?|~|\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?:[-~]\d{1,2}:\d{2})?|\d+학년|각 반|전체)$/.test(title);   const candidate=parts.find(x=>!/(?:^\d{1,2}:\d{2}|^\d+학년$|교시$|희망학생|전체$|각 반|교실$|세미나실$|고당예관$|확정$|예정$|예약$|부$)/.test(x));   if (looksGeneric && candidate) return candidate;   return title || candidate || '일정'; } function inputCenterClassifyMaterial(file={}, textValue=''){   const name=String(file?.name||file?.fileName||'');   const text=String(textValue||file?.text||'');   const [/되었다\.?$/,"됨."],[/이었다\.?$/,"임."],[/알았다\.?$/,"이해함."],[/느꼈다\.?$/,"관심을 보임."],       [/생각했다\.?$/,"자신의 생각을 구체화함."],[/노력했다\.?$/,"꾸준히 노력하는 모습을 보임."],       [/참여하여\.?$/,"참여함."],[/활동하여\.?$/,"활동을 수행함."],[/관찰하여\.?$/,"관찰 내용을 정리함."]     ];     for(const [rx,repl] of replacements){if(rx.test(s)){s=s.replace(rx,repl);break;}}     if(!teacherEnding.test(s)){       s=s.replace(/[,.·\s]+$/,"");       if(/(?:캠페인|활동|실험|특강|프로그램|수련활동|방학식|종업식|입학식)$/.test(s))s+="에 성실히 참여함.";       else if(/(?:참여하여|수행하여|탐구하여|분석하여)$/.test(s))s=s.replace(/하여$/,"함.");       else s+="을 바탕으로 활동 내용을 정리함.";     }     return s;   };   return String(text||"").split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|(?<=…)\s+/).map(convertSentence).filter(Boolean).join(" "); } function normalizedSentenceTokens(text){   return new Set(String(text||"").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu," ").split(/\s+/).filter(x=>x.length>=2)); } function jaccardSimilarity(a,b){   const A=normalizedSentenceTokens(a),B=normalizedSentenceTokens(b);   if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;   let both=0;A.forEach(x=>{if(B.has(x))both++;});   return both/(A.size+B.size-both); } function savedDraftsForArea(area,excludeStudentId){   const rows=[];   for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){     const key=localStorage.key(i)||"";     if(!key.startsWith("uep-record-draft:"))continue;     const parts=key.split(":");const studentId=parts[1],draftArea=parts[2];     if(draftArea===area&&studentId!==excludeStudentId)rows.push({studentId,text:localStorage.getItem(key)||""});   }   return rows; } const OBSERVATION_TAGS=[   ["faithful","활동 안내를 성실히 따르며 주어진 과정에 참여함"],   ["listening","다른 학생의 의견과 설명을 경청함"],   ["role","맡은 역할을 책임감 있게 수행함"],   ["question","궁금한 내용을 질문하거나 추가 자료를 찾아봄"],   ["cooperate","구성원과 협력하여 활동을 수행함"],   ["organize","활동 후 핵심 내용을 정리함"],   ["persistence","과제를 끝까지 수행하려는 태도를 보임"],   ["consideration","주변 학생을 배려하며 공동 활동에 참여함"] ]; function selectedObservationTags(student,area){   try{return `${fmt(start)}-${fmt(end)}`;   return fmt(start||end); } function recordProgramHeading(row){   const p=row.program||reportProgramForRecord(row.report,{programs:readonlyCache?.programs||[]})||{};   // const clauses=[];   const termText=terms.slice(0,4).join("·");   if(termText){     let clause=`${termText}을 중심으로 관련 원리와 활용 사례를 탐색함`; function buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit){   if(!rows.length)return "";   const pieces=rows.map(row=>studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area));   let result=pieces.join(" "); if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); 입결DB와 발굴 계산 원본은 삭제하지 않고 유지합니다. const UEP_VISIBLE_UNIVERSITY_BADGES=[   '서울대','연세대','고려대','서강대','성균관대','한양대','중앙대','경희대','한국외대','서울시립대','건국대','동국대','홍익대','국민대','숭실대',   '충남대','충북대','한밭대','한국교통대' ]; function universityBadgeVisible(name){   const campusKey=universityCampusKey(name);   if(UEP_UNIVERSITY_BRANCH_PRIORITY.some(item=>universityCampusKey(item)===campusKey))return false;   const key=universityNameKey(name);   return UEP_VISIBLE_UNIVERSITY_BADGES.some(item=>universityNameKey(item)===key); } function universityCampusKey(value){   return String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'').replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/캠퍼스/g,''); } function universityPriorityIndex(name){   const campusKey=universityCampusKey(name);   const branchIndex=UEP_UNIVERSITY_BRANCH_PRIORITY.findIndex(item=>universityCampusKey(item)===campusKey);   if(branchIndex>=0) return 200+branchIndex;   const key=universityNameKey(name);   const index=UEP_UNIVERSITY_PRIORITY.findIndex(item=>universityNameKey(item)===key);   return index<0?999:index; } function studentDormBadge(student){   const same=row=>String(row?.studentId||row?.id||'')===String(student?.id||'')||String(row?.studentNo||'')===String(student?.studentNo||'');   const current=(readonlyCache?.dormStudents||[]).filter(same);   const past=(readonlyCache?.pastDormStudents||[]).filter(same);   const has1=past.some(row=>/1/.test(String(row.semester||row.term||'')))||past.length>0;   const has2=current.some(row=>/2/.test(String(row.semester||row.term||'')))||current.length>0;   if(has1&&has2)return {label:'학사 · 연간',rows:[...past,...current]};   if(has2)return {label:'학사 · 2학기',rows:current};   if(has1)return {label:'학사 · 1학기',rows:past};   return null; } function studentVisibleAdmissionRows(student){   let rows=studentAdmissionStageRows(student);   const hasInseoulCore=rows.some(row=>row.group==='inseoul'&&row.stage==='core');   if(hasInseoulCore)rows=rows.filter(row=>!(row.group==='regional'&&row.stage==='core'));   const unique=[];rows.forEach(row=>{if(!unique.some(x=>x.group===row.group&&x.stage===row.stage))unique.push(row);});   return unique; } function normalizeAdmissionMatchText(value){   return String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g,'').trim(); } function admissionTrackKey(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   if(!raw.trim())return [];   const groups=[];   const tests=[     ['의예',/의예|의학|의과/],['치의예',/치의예|치의학|치과/],['약학',/약학|약대/],['한의예',/한의예|한의학/],     ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);   if(!values.length)return null;   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const cacheKey=`${readonlyCache?.syncedAt||''}|${student.id||student.studentNo||''}|badge-evidence-v6-discovery`;   if(studentBadgeCache.has(cacheKey))return studentBadgeCache.get(cacheKey);   const base=admissionBase(student.id);   const snapshot=latestMockSnapshot(student.id);   const mockRows=snapshot.rows||[];   if(base.actual9==null){studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,[]);return [];}   const key=universityNameKey(rule.university);if(!key)return;if(!ruleMap.has(key))ruleMap.set(key,[]);ruleMap.get(key).push(rule);});   const evidence=[];   for(const cut of cuts){     const key=universityNameKey(cut.university);if(!key)continue;     const limit=strictAdmissionCutLimit(cut.cut);if(limit==null||base.actual9>limit)continue;     const universityRules=ruleMap.get(key)||[];     const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null;     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){         accepted={rule,match,check};break;       }     }     if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다.     const checks=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,check:minimumCheck(rule,mockRows)}));     const anyMet=checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='충족'||x.check.result==='미적용');     const allDefiniteFail=checks.length>0&&checks.every(x=>x.check.result==='미충족');     if(allDefiniteFail)continue;     const fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;     evidence.push({       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인 필요':'수능최저 직접대응 없음'),       minimumDetail:fallback?.check?.detail||(cut.minimumLink||'운호고 실제 합격입결 우선 발굴'),mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',       pairReason:compatible.length?'2028 전형 큰 범주 연결':'운호고 실제 합격사례 기반 발굴',pairLevel:compatible[0]?.match?.level||1,       discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'2029 실제 지원 시 최종 모집요강 재검증',discoveryMode:'입결우선 발굴'     });   }   const best=new Map();   evidence.forEach(item=>{const   studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,result);return result; } function studentUniversityBadges(student){   return studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student).map(item=>item.university); } function  function studentStatMetric(student){   const matches=row=>studentMatches(row,student);   // 야자는 참여율이 아니라 실제 참여 횟수를 TOP 선정의 1차 기준으로 사용합니다.   const studentGrowthMetric(row){   const student=row.student, scores=uepRowsForStudent(uepStudentPerfIndex().scoreByStudent,String(student.id||''));   const examOrder=['3월모의고사','6월모의고사','9월모의고사','10월모의고사','11월모의고사','수능'];   const exams=examOrder.map(exam=>{const let weatherState = null; async function loadWeather() {   try {     const response = await fetch(       "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=36.6424&longitude=127.4890&current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,precipitation,wind_speed_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&timezone=Asia%2FSeoul&forecast_days=8",     );     if (!response.ok) throw new Error("weather unavailable");     const data = await response.json();     const now = new Date();     const currentHour = now.getHours();     const hourKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}T${String(currentHour).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;     const currentIndex = Math.max(0, data.hourly.time.indexOf(hourKey));     weatherState = {       temp: Math.round(data.current.temperature_2m),       feels: Math.round(data.current.apparent_temperature),       code: data.current.weather_code,       humidity: data.current.relative_humidity_2m ?? 0,       wind: Math.round((data.current.wind_speed_10m ?? 0) * 10) / 10,       rain: data.hourly.precipitation_probability[currentIndex] ?? 0,       precipitation: data.current.precipitation ?? 0,       daily: data.daily.time.map((time, index) => ({         time,         code: data.daily.weather_code[index],         max: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_max[index]),         min: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_min[index]),         rain: data.daily.precipitation_probability_max[index] ?? 0,       })),       hourly: data.hourly.time.slice(currentIndex, currentIndex + 8).map((time, offset) => {         const index = currentIndex + offset;         return {           time,           code: data.hourly.weather_code[index],           temp: Math.round(data.hourly.temperature_2m[index]),           humidity: data.hourly.relative_humidity_2m[index] ?? 0,           wind: Math.round((data.hourly.wind_speed_10m[index] ?? 0) * 10) / 10,           rain: data.hourly.precipitation_probability[index] ?? 0,         };       }),       updated: new Date(),     };     const label = weatherLabel(weatherState.code);     $("#weatherIcon").textContent = label.icon;     $("#weatherSummary").textContent =       `청주 ${weatherState.temp}℃ · ${label.text}`;     updateHeroWeather();   } catch {     $("#weatherSummary").textContent = "청주 날씨 · 연결 대기";   } } function weatherLabel(code) {   if (code === 0) return { icon: "☀️", text: "맑음" };   if ([1, 2].includes(code)) return { icon: "🌤️", text: "구름 조금" };   if ([3, 45, 48].includes(code)) return { icon: "☁️", text: "흐림" };   if ([51, 53, 55, 61, 63, 65, 80, 81, 82].includes(code))     return { icon: "🌧️", text: "비" };   if ([71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86].includes(code))     return { icon: "🌨️", text: "눈" };   if ([95, 96, 99].includes(code)) return { icon: "⛈️", text: "뇌우" };   return { icon: "○", text: "날씨" }; } function openWeatherDrawer() {   const label = weatherState     ? weatherLabel(weatherState.code)     : { icon: "○", text: "연결 대기" };   $("#drawerKicker").textContent = "WEATHER · CHEONGJU";   $("#drawerTitle").textContent = "날씨 정보";   $("#drawerBody").innerHTML = weatherState     ? `<div class="weather-dashboard"><section class="weather-now"><span>${label.icon}</span><strong>${weatherState.temp}℃</strong><b>${label.text}</b><small>⌖ 청주 · 체감 ${weatherState.feels}℃</small><div><p>습도 <em>${weatherState.humidity}%</em></p><p>풍속 <em>${weatherState.wind}m/s</em></p><p>강수확률 <em>${weatherState.rain}%</em></p></div></section><section class="weather-week"><h3>▣ 주간 예보 <small>최저 / 최고</small></h3><div>${weatherState.daily.map((day, index) => { const item = weatherLabel(day.code); const date = new Date(`${day.time}T00:00:00`); const name = index === 0 ? "오늘" : index === 1 ? "내일" : "일월화수목금토"[date.getDay()]; return `<article><b>${name}</b><small>${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}</small><span>${item.icon}</span><em>${day.rain}%</em><strong>${day.min}° / <i>${day.max}°</i></strong></article>`; }).join("")}</div></section><section class="weather-hourly"><h3>◷ 시간별 예보</h3><div>${weatherState.hourly.map((hour) => { const item = weatherLabel(hour.code); const date = new Date(hour.time); return `<article><small>${date.getHours()}시</small><span>${item.icon}</span><strong>${hour.temp}°</strong><em>강수 ${hour.rain}%</em><em>습도 ${hour.humidity}%</em><em>풍속 ${hour.wind}m/s</em></article>`; }).join("")}</div></section><footer>마지막 업데이트 ${weatherState.updated.getHours()}:${String(weatherState.updated.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")} · 청주 좌표 기준 공개 예보</footer></div>`     : `<div class="connection-guide"><span>○</span><h3>날씨를 불러오지 못했습니다</h3><p>인터넷 연결을 확인한 뒤 앱을 다시 실행해 주세요.</p></div>`;   $("#drawer").classList.add("weather-expanded");   $("#drawer").classList.remove("hidden");   $("#drawerBackdrop").classList.remove("hidden"); } function updateHeroClock() {   const clock = $("#heroClock"),     date = $("#heroDate");   if (!clock || !date) return;   const now = new Date();   const hour = now.getHours(),     period = hour < 12 ? } function openNightAttendanceDetail(studentKey, day, slot) {   const students = readonlyCache?.students || [];   const student = students.find(item => attendanceStudentKey(item) === studentKey) || {};   const rows = readonlyCache?.nightAttendance || readonlyCache?.attendance || [];   const row = rows.find(item => item.date === day && nightSlotName(item) === slot && (attendanceStudentKey(item) === studentKey || String(item.studentNo||"") === String(student.studentNo||""))); } function inputCenterClassifyMaterial(file={}, textValue=''){   const name=String(file?.name||file?.fileName||'');   const text=String(textValue||file?.text||'');   const hay=`${name}\n${text.slice(0,12000)}`.toLowerCase();   const rules=[     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'}, {...best,confidence}; } function inputCenterSpreadsheetRows(file, raw){   const ext=String(file?.extension||'').toLowerCase();   if(!['xls','xlsx','csv','tsv'].includes(ext))return null;   const "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(s.studentNo)} ${escapeHtml(s.name)}</option>`).join(""); }  function scorePeriodKey(row) {   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";   }   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`; } function scorePeriodLabel(key) {   if (!key || key === "all") return "전체 누적";   const [year, semester] = String(key).split("-");   return `${year}학년도 ${semester || "1"}학기`; } function availableScorePeriods(mode = scoreMode) {   const rows = (readonlyCache?.scoreRecords || []).filter(row => mode === "combined" || row.scoreType === (mode === "mock" ? "모의고사" : "내신"));   return [...new Set(rows.map(scorePeriodKey).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b)); } function scoreExamOrder(exam) {   const order = ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사","3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사","수능"];   const index = order.indexOf(exam);   return index < 0 ? 999 : index; } function scoreTrend(row, allRows) {   const orders = row.scoreType === "모의고사" ? ["3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사"] : ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사"];   const index = orders.indexOf(row.exam);   if (index <= 0 || row.level === "" || row.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };   const period = scorePeriodKey(row);   const previous = allRows.find(x => x.studentId === row.studentId && x.scoreType === row.scoreType && x.subject === row.subject && x.exam === orders[index - 1] && scorePeriodKey(x) === period);   if (!previous || previous.level === "" || previous.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };   const diff = Number(previous.level) - Number(row.level);   if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff === 0) return { text:"유지", cls:"" };   return diff > 0 ? { text:`▲ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"good" } : { text:`▼ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"bad" }; } function gradeToneClass(value) {   const grade = Number(value);   return Number.isFinite(grade) && grade >= 1 && grade <= 9 ? `grade-${grade}` : "grade-na"; } function gradeBadgeMarkup(value, suffix = "등급") {   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined || value === "-") return `<span class="grade-badge grade-na">-</span>`;   const number = Number(value);   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return `<span class="grade-badge grade-na">${escapeHtml(String(value))}</span>`;   return `<span class="grade-badge ${gradeToneClass(number)}"><b>${scoreDisplay(number,2)}</b><small>${suffix}</small></span>`; } function mockGradeMiniMarkup(studentId, exam) {   const order = ["국어", "수학", "영어", "한국사"];   const rows = (readonlyCache?.scoreRecords || []).filter(row => row.studentId === studentId && row.scoreType === "모의고사" && row.exam === exam);   if (!rows.length) return `<span class="mock-grade-empty">자료 없음</span>`;   const sorted = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>{     const ai=order.indexOf(a.subject), bi=order.indexOf(b.subject);     if(ai>=0||bi>=0) return (ai<0?99:ai)-(bi<0?99:bi);     return String(a.subject).localeCompare(String(b.subject),"ko");   });   return `<div class="mock-grade-mini-strip">${sorted.map(row=>`<span><small>${escapeHtml(row.subject)}</small><b class="${gradeToneClass(row.level)}">${escapeHtml(String(row.level || "-"))}</b></span>`).join("")}</div>`; } function scoreTableMarkup(rows, mode = scoreMode) {   const coreOrder = mode === "mock" ? ["국어","수학","영어","한국사"] : ["공통국어1","공통수학1","공통영어1","한국사1","통합사회1","통합과학1","한문","과학탐구실험1","체육1","음악"];   const subjects = [...new Set(rows.map(row=>row.subject).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>{     const ai=coreOrder.indexOf(a), bi=coreOrder.indexOf(b);     if(ai>=0||bi>=0) return (ai<0?999:ai)-(bi<0?999:bi);     return a.localeCompare(b,"ko");   });   const groups = new Map();   rows.forEach(row=>{     const period = scorePeriodKey(row);     const key=`${row.studentId}|${period}|${row.exam}`;     if(!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key,{studentId:row.studentId,studentNo:row.studentNo,name:row.name,period,exam:row.exam,items:new Map()});     groups.get(key).items.set(row.subject,row);   });   const grouped=[...groups.values()].sort((a,b)=>String(a.studentNo).localeCompare(String(b.studentNo)) || a.period.localeCompare(b.period) || scoreExamOrder(a.exam)-scoreExamOrder(b.exam) || String(a.exam).localeCompare(String(b.exam),"ko"));   const cell=(row)=>{     if(!row) return `<td class="empty-score-cell">-</td>`;     const trend=scoreTrend(row,readonlyCache?.scoreRecords||[]);     const trendMarkup=trend.text!=="-"?`<em class="trend ${trend.cls}">${trend.text}</em>`:"";     if(row.scoreType==="모의고사") return `<td><div class="score-cell-primary">${gradeBadgeMarkup(row.level)}${trendMarkup}</div><small>원점수 ${scoreDisplay(row.rawScore)} · 표준 ${scoreDisplay(row.standardScore)}${row.percentile!==""?` · 백분위 ${scoreDisplay(row.percentile)}`:""}</small></td>`;     const gradeValue = row.level === "산출제외" ? "모의고사 과목별 등급" : "내신 과목별 등급";   return `<div class="data-card score-matrix-card"><div class="card-head"><div><strong>${title}</strong></div><small>전체 누적 또는 선택 학기를 표시합니다.</small></div><div class="score-matrix-scroll"><table class="score-matrix-table"><thead><tr><th class="student-col">학생</th><th class="exam-col">학기·시험</th>${subjects.map(subject=>`<th>${escapeHtml(subject)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${grouped.map(group=>`<tr><th class="student-col"><b>${escapeHtml(group.studentNo)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(group.name)}</small></th><th class="exam-col"><b>${escapeHtml(scorePeriodLabel(group.period).replace("학년도 ","· "))}</b><small>${escapeHtml(group.exam)}</small></th>${subjects.map(subject=>cell(group.items.get(subject))).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div></div>`; }  function scoreDisplay(value, digits = 1) {   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined || value === "-") return "-";   const number = Number(value);   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return escapeHtml(String(value));   return Number.isInteger(number) ? String(number) : number.toFixed(digits).replace(/\.0+$/, ""); } function scoreAverage(rows) {   const values = rows.filter((row) => row.level !== "" && row.level !== null && row.level !== undefined).map((row) => Number(row.level)).filter(Number.isFinite);   return values.length ? values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length : null; } function combinedScoreDashboardMarkup(student, rows) {   const allRows = readonlyCache?.scoreRecords || [];   const scopedRows = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.filter(row=>row.studentId===student.id) : allRows.filter(row=>row.studentId===student.id);   const internal = scopedRows.filter((row) => row.scoreType === "내신");   const mock = scopedRows.filter((row) => row.scoreType === "모의고사");   const internalPeriods = [...new Set(internal.map(scorePeriodKey))].sort();   const latestInternalPeriod = internalPeriods.at(-1) || "";   const summaryInternal = scorePeriod === "all" && latestInternalPeriod ? internal.filter(row=>scorePeriodKey(row)===latestInternalPeriod) : internal;   const periodLabel = scorePeriodLabel(scorePeriod);   const coreInternalOrder = ["공통국어1","공통수학1","공통영어1","한국사1","통합사회1","통합과학1","한문","과학탐구실험1","체육1","음악"];   const internalSubjects = [...new Set(summaryInternal.map((row) => row.subject).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => {     const ai = coreInternalOrder.indexOf(a), bi = coreInternalOrder.indexOf(b);     if (ai >= 0 || bi >= 0) return (ai < 0 ? 999 : ai) - (bi < 0 ? 999 : bi);     return a.localeCompare(b, "ko");   });   const byInternal = (subject, exam) => summaryInternal.find((row) => row.subject === subject && row.exam === exam);   const internalRows = internalSubjects.map((subject) => {     const first = byInternal(subject, "1차고사"), second = byInternal(subject, "2차고사"), final = byInternal(subject, "학기말고사");     const finalGrade = final?.level === "산출제외" ? function runScoreQuery() {   const scope = $("#scoreScope")?.value || "class";   const classNo = $("#scoreClass")?.value || "";   const studentId = $("#scoreStudent")?.value || "";   const exam = (!studentId) { target.innerHTML = `<div class="query-empty"><b>학생을 선택하세요.</b><span>반을 먼저 선택한 뒤 학생을 고르고 조회하세요.</span></div>`; return; }     rows = rows.filter(x => x.studentId === studentId);   } else {     if (!classNo) { target.innerHTML = `<div class="query-empty"><b>반을 선택하세요.</b><span>반을 선택한 뒤 조회 버튼을 눌러야 성적이 표시됩니다.</span></div>`; return; }     const ids = new Set((readonlyCache?.students || []).filter(s => classNumberOf(s) === String(classNo)).map(s=>s.id));     rows = rows.filter(x => ids.has(x.studentId));   }   if (scoreMode === "combined" && scope !== "individual") { target.innerHTML <input type="date" data-career-date-input="${escapeHtml(key)}" value="${escapeHtml(value.date||"")}">     <input type="number" min="1" max="20" step="1" placeholder="이수시간" ${escapeHtml(careerMatchedHours(value))}시간`:""}</small>   </div>`; } function enforceTeacherEnding(text){   const teacherEnding=/함\.?$|됨\.?$|임\.?$|보임\.?$|돋보임\.?$|기여함\.?$|발휘함\.?$|확장함\.?$|심화함\.?$|이해함\.?$|수행함\.?$|참여함\.?$/;   const convertSentence=sentence=>{     let s=String(sentence||"").replace(/…+$/,"").trim();if(!s)return "";     const replacements=[       [/하였습니다?\.?$/,"함."],[/했습니다?\.?$/,"함."],[/하였다\.?$/,"함."],[/했다\.?$/,"함."],       [/되었다\.?$/,"됨."],[/이었다\.?$/,"임."],[/알았다\.?$/,"이해함."],[/느꼈다\.?$/,"관심을 보임."],       [/생각했다\.?$/,"자신의 생각을 구체화함."],[/노력했다\.?$/,"꾸준히 노력하는 모습을 보임."],       [/참여하여\.?$/,"참여함."],[/활동하여\.?$/,"활동을 수행함."],[/관찰하여\.?$/,"관찰 내용을 정리함."]     ];     for(const [rx,repl] of replacements){if(rx.test(s)){s=s.replace(rx,repl);break;}}     if(!teacherEnding.test(s)){       s=s.replace(/[,.·\s]+$/,"");       if(/(?:캠페인|활동|실험|특강|프로그램|수련활동|방학식|종업식|입학식)$/.test(s))s+="에 성실히 참여함.";       else if(/(?:참여하여|수행하여|탐구하여|분석하여)$/.test(s))s=s.replace(/하여$/,"함.");       else s+="을 바탕으로 활동 내용을 정리함.";     }     return s;   };   return String(text||"").split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|(?<=…)\s+/).map(convertSentence).filter(Boolean).join(" "); } function normalizedSentenceTokens(text){   return new Set(String(text||"").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu," ").split(/\s+/).filter(x=>x.length>=2)); } function jaccardSimilarity(a,b){   const A=normalizedSentenceTokens(a),B=normalizedSentenceTokens(b);   if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;   let both=0;A.forEach(x=>{if(B.has(x))both++;});   return both/(A.size+B.size-both); } function savedDraftsForArea(area,excludeStudentId){   const rows=[];   for(let `${fmt(start)}-${fmt(end)}`;   return fmt(start||end); } function recordProgramHeading(row){   const p=row.program||reportProgramForRecord(row.report,{programs:readonlyCache?.programs||[]})||{};   // while((m=re.exec(text))!==null){matches.push(m[0]); if(m.index===re.lastIndex)re.lastIndex++;}   return [...new Set(matches)].slice(0,8); } function evidenceSentence(text,words){   if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'진로계열',key,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   const majors=MAJOR_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'전공군',key:label,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   return {sdgs,careers,majors,text}; } } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g,'').trim(); } function admissionTrackKey(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   if(!raw.trim())return [];   const groups=[];   const tests=[     ['의예',/의예|의학|의과/],['치의예',/치의예|치의학|치과/],['약학',/약학|약대/],['한의예',/한의예|한의학/],     ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);   if(!values.length)return null;   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const  const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null;     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){         accepted={rule,match,check};break;       }     }     if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다. fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;     evidence.push({       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인  function studentStatMetric(student){   const matches=row=>studentMatches(row,student);   // 야자는 참여율이 아니라 실제 참여 횟수를 TOP 선정의 1차 기준으로 사용합니다.   const let weatherState = null; async function loadWeather() {   try {     const response = await fetch(       "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=36.6424&longitude=127.4890&current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,precipitation,wind_speed_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&timezone=Asia%2FSeoul&forecast_days=8",     );     if (!response.ok) throw new Error("weather unavailable");     const data = await response.json();     const now = new Date();     const currentHour = now.getHours();     const hourKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}T${String(currentHour).padStart(2, "0")}:00`; }  function calendarEventTargetsFirstGrade(event) {   const target = String(event?.target || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();   const detail = String(event?.detail || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/\(?1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]?\s*2?\s*학년부[^)]*\)?/g, " ");   if (/학부모/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;   if (/교사|교직원/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;   const text = target || detail;   return /(?:^|[^0-9])1\s*학년/.test(text)     || /1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]\s*2\s*학년/.test(text)     || /1\s*[~-]\s*3\s*학년/.test(text)     || /전교생|전체\s*학생/.test(text); }  function calendarEventLooksLikeProgram(event) {   const text = `${event?.title || ""} ${event?.target || ""} ${event?.detail || ""}`;   if (/(정기고사|기말고사|중간고사|방학식|개학식|교직원회의|부장교사회의|운영위원회|석식\s*[Xx]|급식제공|시간표\s*운영|교실개방|생활기록부.*점검|입찰|폐지\(|폐기물|제안서.*제출기간)/.test(text)) return false;   return /(프로그램|특강|체험|교육|설명회|공연|상담|탐방|캠프|연수|활동|동아리|수련|수학여행|대회|촬영|학습코칭|석학과의 만남)/.test(text); }  function calendarEventVisualKind(event) {   if (/개인/.test(String(event?.type || ""))) return "personal";   if (calendarEventLooksLikeProgram(event)) return "program";   return "school"; }  function calendarEventMatchesFilter(event) {   if (calendarFilter === "all") return true;   if (calendarFilter === "pending") return calendarEventIsPending(event);   return calendarEventVisualKind(event) === calendarFilter; }  function calendarDisplayTitle(event) {   const title=String(event?.title||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();   const raw=String(event?.originalDetail||event?.detail||'').replace(/\r/g,'');   const parts=raw.split(/[\n/]+/).map(x=>x.replace(/^\([^)]*\)\s*/,'').trim()).filter(Boolean);   const looksGeneric = !title || /^(?:\(?\d+[-~]?\d*교시\)?|\(?\d+[-~]\d+교시\)?|~|\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?:[-~]\d{1,2}:\d{2})?|\d+학년|각 반|전체)$/.test(title);   const candidate=parts.find(x=>!/(?:^\d{1,2}:\d{2}|^\d+학년$|교시$|희망학생|전체$|각 반|교실$|세미나실$|고당예관$|확정$|예정$|예약$|부$)/.test(x));   if (looksGeneric && candidate) return candidate;   return title || candidate || '일정'; }  function calendarShortTitle(title, max = 18) {   const value = String(title || "일정").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();   return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max)}…` : value; }  function calendarDayTone(key) {   const date = new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`);   const weekday = date.getDay();   const holiday = attendanceIsSchoolHoliday(key);   return {     holiday,     saturday: weekday === 6 && !holiday,     sunday: weekday === 0 && !holiday,     className: holiday ? "holiday" : weekday === 6 ? "saturday" : weekday === 0 ? "sunday" : "weekday",   }; }  function calendarSelectedDayMarkup() {   const events = schoolEventsForDate(calendarSelectedDate).filter(calendarEventMatchesFilter);   const date = new Date(`${calendarSelectedDate}T12:00:00`);   const label = `${date.getMonth() + 1}월 ${date.getDate()}일 ${weekdayLabelFromKey(calendarSelectedDate, true)}`;   return `<section class="calendar-selected-day"><div class="calendar-selected-head"><div><small>SELECTED DAY</small><h4>${escapeHtml(label)} · ${events.length}개 일정</h4></div><button data-page="calendar">전체 일정 보기</button></div><div class="calendar-selected-list">${events.length ? ','T');   const m=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})T(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);   if(m) return dormOutingExcludedByRule(item){   // 병원 외출은 학사운영규칙의 학원외출 허용/미운영 판정과 무관한 개인 외출사유입니다.   // 신청이 존재하면 오늘의 학사외출현황과 메일/출력 대상에서 제외하지 않습니다.   if(dormOutingIsMedical(item))return false;   const ({period:'운영',closure:'미운영',base:'운영',exception:'입퇴소변경',exam:'개인외출허용',vacation:'개인외출허용'})[category]||''; } function dormRuleEffectDefault(category){   return ({period:'운영기간',closure:'학사 미운영(퇴소~입소 Date(end);if(Number.isNaN(a.getTime())||Number.isNaN(b.getTime()))return '전체';   const names=['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'],seen=[];   const d=new Date(a);d.setHours(12,0,0,0);const stop=new [/되었다\.?$/,"됨."],[/이었다\.?$/,"임."],[/알았다\.?$/,"이해함."],[/느꼈다\.?$/,"관심을 보임."],       [/생각했다\.?$/,"자신의 생각을 구체화함."],[/노력했다\.?$/,"꾸준히 노력하는 모습을 보임."],       [/참여하여\.?$/,"참여함."],[/활동하여\.?$/,"활동을 function buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit){   if(!rows.length)return "";   const pieces=rows.map(row=>studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area));   let result=pieces.join(" "); while((m=re.exec(text))!==null){matches.push(m[0]); if(m.index===re.lastIndex)re.lastIndex++;}   return [...new Set(matches)].slice(0,8); } function evidenceSentence(text,words){   if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'진로계열',key,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   const majors=MAJOR_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'전공군',key:label,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   return {sdgs,careers,majors,text}; } .filter(x=>x.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.no-b.no).slice(0,4); } function reportImprovementAdvice(row){   const responses=(row.report?.responses||[]).filter(Boolean);   const } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],   }[type] || [];   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };   return String(text || raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const  const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null; if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다. allDefiniteFail=checks.length>0&&checks.every(x=>x.check.result==='미충족');     if(allDefiniteFail)continue;     const fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;     evidence.push({       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인 pairReason:compatible.length?'2028 전형 큰 범주 연결':'운호고 실제 합격사례 기반 발굴',pairLevel:compatible[0]?.match?.level||1,       discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'2029 실제 지원 시 최종 모집요강 재검증',discoveryMode:'입결우선 발굴'     });   }   const best=new Map();   evidence.forEach(item=>{const   return calendarEventVisualKind(event) === calendarFilter; }  function calendarDisplayTitle(event) {   const title=String(event?.title||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();   const raw=String(event?.originalDetail||event?.detail||'').replace(/\r/g,''); hay=`${name}\n${text.slice(0,12000)}`.toLowerCase();   const rules=[     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'}, 활용한 인슐린 생산 원리를 추가로 조사하며 생명공학 기술의 실제 활용 과정을 구체적으로 이해함`;     clauses.push(clause);   }   if(career&&/진로|전공|의학|생명|공학|환경|AI|인공지능|경제|법|교육/.test(career)){     const if(/도움|질병|치료|해결|피해|개선/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동에서 생긴 질문을 바탕으로 기술이 실제 문제 해결에 활용되는 조건과 한계를 더 알아보고자 탐구 범위를 확장함`);     else if(/찾|검색|조사|알아/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동 후 궁금한 내용을 추가로 조사하며 탐구를 이어감`);   }   if(growth&&/이해|알게|처음|어려|검색|찾아|해결|성장|변화/.test(growth))clauses.push(`이해가 부족했던 내용을 이전 학습과 추가 자료 탐색을 통해 보완하며 자신의 이해 과정을 구체화함`);   if(area==="behavior"&&/봉사|임원|회장|반장|실장|도우미/.test(`${row.title||""} ${full}`))clauses.push("공동체 활동에서 맡은 역할을 수행하며 구성원과 함께 활동하는 모습을 보임");   return [...new Set(clauses)].slice(0,3); } function studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area){   const heading=recordProgramHeading(row);   if(row.report){     const clauses=reportInterpretationClauses(row,area);     if(clauses.length)return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 ${clauses.join(". ")}`);   }   if(row.kind==="activity")return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에서 공동체의 일원으로 확인되는 활동과 역할을 수행함`);   return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 확인 가능한 활동 내용을 바탕으로 교육활동에 참여함`); }  function buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit){   if(!rows.length)return "";   const pieces=rows.map(row=>studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area));   let result=pieces.join(" ");   result=enforceTeacherEnding(result);   if(result.length<=limit)return result;   const per=Math.max(60,Math.floor((limit-(rows.length-1))/rows.length));   result=pieces.map(piece=>piece.length>per?enforceTeacherEnding(piece.slice(0,Math.max(20,per-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "")):piece).join(" ");   if(result.length>limit)result=result.slice(0,Math.max(20,limit-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "");   return enforceTeacherEnding(result).slice(0,limit); }  const SDG_CATALOG=[   [1,"빈곤 while((m=re.exec(text))!==null){matches.push(m[0]); if(m.index===re.lastIndex)re.lastIndex++;}   return [...new Set(matches)].slice(0,8); } function evidenceSentence(text,words){   if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'진로계열',key,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   const majors=MAJOR_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'전공군',key:label,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   return {sdgs,careers,majors,text}; } .filter(x=>x.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.no-b.no).slice(0,4); } function reportImprovementAdvice(row){   const responses=(row.report?.responses||[]).filter(Boolean);   const } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); (!rows.length) return '<div class="reference-detail"><div class="outing-empty">등록된 자료가 없습니다. 표 전체 편집에서 원본 표를 붙여넣으세요.</div></div>';   if (type === "homeroom") {     const grades = [...new `<small>${escapeHtml(row[2])}</small>` : ""}</div>`).join("")}</div>`; }  function parseReferencePaste(text, type) {   const headers = {     approval: ["업무분류", "업무 종류", "결재라인", "비고"],     homeroom: ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],   }[type] || [];   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };   return String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {     const cells = (line.includes("\t") ? line.split("\t") : line.split(/\s{2,}|,/))       .map((cell) => String(cell || "").trim());     while (cells.length && String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g,'').trim(); } function admissionTrackKey(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   if(!raw.trim())return [];   const groups=[];   const tests=[     ['의예',/의예|의학|의과/],['치의예',/치의예|치의학|치과/],['약학',/약학|약대/],['한의예',/한의예|한의학/],     ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);   if(!values.length)return null;   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const cacheKey=`${readonlyCache?.syncedAt||''}|${student.id||student.studentNo||''}|badge-evidence-v6-discovery`;   if(studentBadgeCache.has(cacheKey))return studentBadgeCache.get(cacheKey);   const cuts=(readonlyCache?.admissionCuts||[]).filter(cut=>String(cut.discoveryUse||'Y').toUpperCase()!=='N');   const rules=(readonlyCache?.admissionMinimums||[]).filter(rule=>String(rule.discoveryStatus||'').trim()!=='사용보류');   const ruleMap=new Map();   rules.forEach(rule=>{const key=universityNameKey(rule.university);if(!key)return;if(!ruleMap.has(key))ruleMap.set(key,[]);ruleMap.get(key).push(rule);});   const evidence=[];   for(const cut of cuts){     const key=universityNameKey(cut.university);if(!key)continue;     const limit=strictAdmissionCutLimit(cut.cut);if(limit==null||base.actual9>limit)continue;     const universityRules=ruleMap.get(key)||[];     const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null;     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){         accepted={rule,match,check};break;       }     }     if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다. allDefiniteFail=checks.length>0&&checks.every(x=>x.check.result==='미충족');     if(allDefiniteFail)continue;     const fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;     evidence.push({       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인 필요':'수능최저 직접대응 없음'),       minimumDetail:fallback?.check?.detail||(cut.minimumLink||'운호고 실제 합격입결 우선 발굴'),mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',       pairReason:compatible.length?'2028 전형 큰 범주 연결':'운호고 실제 합격사례 기반 발굴',pairLevel:compatible[0]?.match?.level||1,       discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'2029 실제 지원 시 최종 모집요강 재검증',discoveryMode:'입결우선 발굴'     });   }   const best=new Map();   evidence.forEach(item=>{const key=universityNameKey(item.university),prev=best.get(key);if(!prev||item.pairLevel>prev.pairLevel||(item.pairLevel===prev.pairLevel&&item.limit<prev.limit))best.set(key,item);});   const   studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,result);return result; } function studentUniversityBadges(student){   return studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student).map(item=>item.university); } function   return calendarEventVisualKind(event) === calendarFilter; }  function calendarDisplayTitle(event) {   const title=String(event?.title||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();   const raw=String(event?.originalDetail||event?.detail||'').replace(/\r/g,''); hay=`${name}\n${text.slice(0,12000)}`.toLowerCase();   const rules=[     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'}, 활용한 인슐린 생산 원리를 추가로 조사하며 생명공학 기술의 실제 활용 과정을 구체적으로 이해함`;     clauses.push(clause);   }   if(career&&/진로|전공|의학|생명|공학|환경|AI|인공지능|경제|법|교육/.test(career)){     const if(/도움|질병|치료|해결|피해|개선/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동에서 생긴 질문을 바탕으로 기술이 실제 문제 해결에 활용되는 조건과 한계를 더 알아보고자 탐구 범위를 확장함`);     else if(/찾|검색|조사|알아/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동 후 궁금한 내용을 추가로 조사하며 탐구를 이어감`);   }   if(growth&&/이해|알게|처음|어려|검색|찾아|해결|성장|변화/.test(growth))clauses.push(`이해가 부족했던 내용을 이전 학습과 추가 자료 탐색을 통해 보완하며 자신의 이해 과정을 구체화함`);   if(area==="behavior"&&/봉사|임원|회장|반장|실장|도우미/.test(`${row.title||""} ${full}`))clauses.push("공동체 활동에서 맡은 역할을 수행하며 구성원과 함께 활동하는 모습을 보임");   return [...new Set(clauses)].slice(0,3); } function studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area){   const heading=recordProgramHeading(row);   if(row.report){     const clauses=reportInterpretationClauses(row,area);     if(clauses.length)return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 ${clauses.join(". ")}`);   }   if(row.kind==="activity")return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에서 공동체의 일원으로 확인되는 활동과 역할을 수행함`);   return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 확인 가능한 활동 내용을 바탕으로 교육활동에 참여함`); }  function buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit){   if(!rows.length)return "";   const pieces=rows.map(row=>studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area));   let result=pieces.join(" ");   result=enforceTeacherEnding(result);   if(result.length<=limit)return result;   const per=Math.max(60,Math.floor((limit-(rows.length-1))/rows.length));   result=pieces.map(piece=>piece.length>per?enforceTeacherEnding(piece.slice(0,Math.max(20,per-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "")):piece).join(" ");   if(result.length>limit)result=result.slice(0,Math.max(20,limit-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "");   return enforceTeacherEnding(result).slice(0,limit); }  const SDG_CATALOG=[   [1,"빈곤 while((m=re.exec(text))!==null){matches.push(m[0]); if(m.index===re.lastIndex)re.lastIndex++;}   return [...new Set(matches)].slice(0,8); } function evidenceSentence(text,words){   if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'진로계열',key,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   const majors=MAJOR_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'전공군',key:label,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   return {sdgs,careers,majors,text}; } .filter(x=>x.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.no-b.no).slice(0,4); } function reportImprovementAdvice(row){   const responses=(row.report?.responses||[]).filter(Boolean);   const } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); (!rows.length) return '<div class="reference-detail"><div class="outing-empty">등록된 자료가 없습니다. 표 전체 편집에서 원본 표를 붙여넣으세요.</div></div>';   if (type === "homeroom") {     const grades = [...new `<small>${escapeHtml(row[2])}</small>` : ""}</div>`).join("")}</div>`; }  function parseReferencePaste(text, type) {   const headers = {     approval: ["업무분류", "업무 종류", "결재라인", "비고"],     homeroom: ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],   }[type] || [];   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };   return String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {     const cells = (line.includes("\t") ? line.split("\t") : line.split(/\s{2,}|,/))       .map((cell) => String(cell || "").trim());     while (cells.length && String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g,'').trim(); } function admissionTrackKey(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   if(!raw.trim())return [];   const groups=[];   const tests=[     ['의예',/의예|의학|의과/],['치의예',/치의예|치의학|치과/],['약학',/약학|약대/],['한의예',/한의예|한의학/],     ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);   if(!values.length)return null;   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const cacheKey=`${readonlyCache?.syncedAt||''}|${student.id||student.studentNo||''}|badge-evidence-v6-discovery`;   if(studentBadgeCache.has(cacheKey))return studentBadgeCache.get(cacheKey);   const cuts=(readonlyCache?.admissionCuts||[]).filter(cut=>String(cut.discoveryUse||'Y').toUpperCase()!=='N');   const rules=(readonlyCache?.admissionMinimums||[]).filter(rule=>String(rule.discoveryStatus||'').trim()!=='사용보류');   const ruleMap=new Map();   rules.forEach(rule=>{const key=universityNameKey(rule.university);if(!key)return;if(!ruleMap.has(key))ruleMap.set(key,[]);ruleMap.get(key).push(rule);});   const evidence=[];   for(const cut of cuts){     const key=universityNameKey(cut.university);if(!key)continue;     const limit=strictAdmissionCutLimit(cut.cut);if(limit==null||base.actual9>limit)continue;     const universityRules=ruleMap.get(key)||[];     const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null;     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){         accepted={rule,match,check};break;       }     }     if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다. allDefiniteFail=checks.length>0&&checks.every(x=>x.check.result==='미충족');     if(allDefiniteFail)continue;     const fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;     evidence.push({       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인 필요':'수능최저 직접대응 없음'),       minimumDetail:fallback?.check?.detail||(cut.minimumLink||'운호고 실제 합격입결 우선 발굴'),mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',       pairReason:compatible.length?'2028 전형 큰 범주 연결':'운호고 실제 합격사례 기반 발굴',pairLevel:compatible[0]?.match?.level||1,       discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'2029 실제 지원 시 최종 모집요강 재검증',discoveryMode:'입결우선 발굴'     });   }   const best=new Map();   evidence.forEach(item=>{const key=universityNameKey(item.university),prev=best.get(key);if(!prev||item.pairLevel>prev.pairLevel||(item.pairLevel===prev.pairLevel&&item.limit<prev.limit))best.set(key,item);});   const   studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,result);return result; } function studentUniversityBadges(student){   return studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student).map(item=>item.university); } function   return calendarEventVisualKind(event) === calendarFilter; }  function calendarDisplayTitle(event) {   const title=String(event?.title||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();   const raw=String(event?.originalDetail||event?.detail||'').replace(/\r/g,''); hay=`${name}\n${text.slice(0,12000)}`.toLowerCase();   const rules=[     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'}, 활용한 인슐린 생산 원리를 추가로 조사하며 생명공학 기술의 실제 활용 과정을 구체적으로 이해함`;     clauses.push(clause);   }   if(career&&/진로|전공|의학|생명|공학|환경|AI|인공지능|경제|법|교육/.test(career)){     const if(/도움|질병|치료|해결|피해|개선/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동에서 생긴 질문을 바탕으로 기술이 실제 문제 해결에 활용되는 조건과 한계를 더 알아보고자 탐구 범위를 확장함`);     else if(/찾|검색|조사|알아/.test(follow))clauses.push(`활동 후 궁금한 내용을 추가로 조사하며 탐구를 이어감`);   }   if(growth&&/이해|알게|처음|어려|검색|찾아|해결|성장|변화/.test(growth))clauses.push(`이해가 부족했던 내용을 이전 학습과 추가 자료 탐색을 통해 보완하며 자신의 이해 과정을 구체화함`);   if(area==="behavior"&&/봉사|임원|회장|반장|실장|도우미/.test(`${row.title||""} ${full}`))clauses.push("공동체 활동에서 맡은 역할을 수행하며 구성원과 함께 활동하는 모습을 보임");   return [...new Set(clauses)].slice(0,3); } function studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area){   const heading=recordProgramHeading(row);   if(row.report){     const clauses=reportInterpretationClauses(row,area);     if(clauses.length)return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 ${clauses.join(". ")}`);   }   if(row.kind==="activity")return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에서 공동체의 일원으로 확인되는 활동과 역할을 수행함`);   return enforceTeacherEnding(`${heading}에 참여하여 확인 가능한 활동 내용을 바탕으로 교육활동에 참여함`); }  function buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit){   if(!rows.length)return "";   const pieces=rows.map(row=>studentCenteredRecordPiece(row,area));   let result=pieces.join(" ");   result=enforceTeacherEnding(result);   if(result.length<=limit)return result;   const per=Math.max(60,Math.floor((limit-(rows.length-1))/rows.length));   result=pieces.map(piece=>piece.length>per?enforceTeacherEnding(piece.slice(0,Math.max(20,per-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "")):piece).join(" ");   if(result.length>limit)result=result.slice(0,Math.max(20,limit-16)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "");   return enforceTeacherEnding(result).slice(0,limit); }  const SDG_CATALOG=[   [1,"빈곤 while((m=re.exec(text))!==null){matches.push(m[0]); if(m.index===re.lastIndex)re.lastIndex++;}   return [...new Set(matches)].slice(0,8); } function evidenceSentence(text,words){   if(!words.length)return '';   const parts=String(text||'').split(/(?<=[.!?。]|다\.)\s+|\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);   return parts.find(x=>words.some(w=>x.includes(w)))||parts[0]||''; } function analyzeReportTags(report){   const text=[report?.programName,report?.reportGroup,...(report?.responses||[])].filter(Boolean).join(' ');   const sdgs=SDG_CATALOG.map(([no,name,rx])=>{const ${name}`,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||Number(a.key)-Number(b.key)).slice(0,3);   const careers=CAREER_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,key,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'진로계열',key,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   const majors=MAJOR_TAG_CATALOG.map(([label,rx])=>{const words=tagMatches(text,rx);return {type:'전공군',key:label,label,score:words.length,words,sentence:evidenceSentence(text,words)};}).filter(x=>x.score).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3);   return {sdgs,careers,majors,text}; } .filter(x=>x.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.no-b.no).slice(0,4); } function reportImprovementAdvice(row){   const responses=(row.report?.responses||[]).filter(Boolean);   const } function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end); (!rows.length) return '<div class="reference-detail"><div class="outing-empty">등록된 자료가 없습니다. 표 전체 편집에서 원본 표를 붙여넣으세요.</div></div>';   if (type === "homeroom") {     const grades = [...new `<small>${escapeHtml(row[2])}</small>` : ""}</div>`).join("")}</div>`; }  function parseReferencePaste(text, type) {   const headers = {     approval: ["업무분류", "업무 종류", "결재라인", "비고"],     homeroom: ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],   }[type] || [];   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };   return String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {     const cells = (line.includes("\t") ? line.split("\t") : line.split(/\s{2,}|,/))       .map((cell) => String(cell || "").trim());     while (cells.length && String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/대학교/g,'대').replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g,'').trim(); } function admissionTrackKey(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   const text=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(raw);   if(!text)return '';   // 전형명은 학교별 표현이 달라도 같은 선발 방식이면 동일 전형군으로 연결합니다.   if(/학생부종합|학종|종합전형|학교생활우수|자기추천|참인재|do dream|do드림/.test(raw))return '학생부종합';   if(/논술/.test(raw))return '논술';   if(/특기|실기/.test(raw))return '실기특기';   if(/지역인재/.test(raw))return '지역인재';   if(/지역균형|학교장추천|학교추천|추천형|추천전형|고교추천|균형교과|고교연계|학생부교과|교과우수|교과전형|교과성적|교과100|교과 100/.test(raw))return '학생부교과';   return text; } function admissionUnitTokens(value){   const raw=String(value||'').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();   if(!raw.trim())return [];   const groups=[];   const tests=[     ['의예',/의예|의학|의과/],['치의예',/치의예|치의학|치과/],['약학',/약학|약대/],['한의예',/한의예|한의학/],     ['간호보건',/간호|보건|의료/],['공학',/공학|공과|공대|전자|전기|기계|컴퓨터|소프트웨어|인공지능|반도체|화공|신소재|건축|토목/],     ['자연',/자연|이공|과학|수학|물리|화학|생명|환경/],['인문사회',/인문|사회|상경|경영|경제|행정|정치|국문|영문|외국어|사학|철학|교육/],     ['예체능',/예체능|예술|체육|미술|음악/]   ];   tests.forEach(([key,re])=>{if(re.test(raw))groups.push(key);});   return groups; } function admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule){   const cutTrack=admissionTrackKey(cut?.track||cut?.name), ruleTrack=admissionTrackKey(rule?.name||rule?.type);   const cutName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.name), ruleName=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.name);   const cutUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(cut?.unit), ruleUnit=normalizeAdmissionMatchText(rule?.unit);   const cutGroups=admissionUnitTokens(cut?.unit), ruleGroups=admissionUnitTokens(rule?.unit);   const trackExact=Boolean(cutName&&ruleName&&cutName===ruleName);   const trackGroup=Boolean(cutTrack&&ruleTrack&&cutTrack===ruleTrack);   const unitExact=Boolean(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&(cutUnit===ruleUnit||cutUnit.includes(ruleUnit)||ruleUnit.includes(cutUnit)));   const unitGroup=Boolean(cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&cutGroups.some(x=>ruleGroups.includes(x)));   // 모집단위가 양쪽에 명시됐는데 계열까지 충돌하면 같은 근거로 묶지 않습니다.   if(cutUnit&&ruleUnit&&!unitExact&&cutGroups.length&&ruleGroups.length&&!unitGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'모집단위 불일치'};   // 전형명이 양쪽에 명시된 경우 정확일치 또는 표준 전형군 일치가 필요합니다.   if(cutName&&ruleName&&!trackExact&&!trackGroup)return {ok:false,reason:'전형군 불일치'};   if(trackExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형명 정확일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitExact)return {ok:true,level:4,reason:'전형군+모집단위 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&unitGroup)return {ok:true,level:3,reason:'전형군+모집계열 일치'};   if(trackGroup&&(!cutUnit||!ruleUnit))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:'전형군 일치·한쪽 모집단위 미기재'};   // 한 DB에 전형명이 비어 있어도 모집단위가 명확히 연결되면 허용합니다.   if((!cutName||!ruleName)&&(unitExact||unitGroup))return {ok:true,level:2,reason:unitExact?'모집단위 일치':'모집계열 일치'};   return {ok:false,reason:'동일 전형 근거 부족'}; } function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);   if(!values.length)return null;   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.   return Math.min(...values); } function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){   const cacheKey=`${readonlyCache?.syncedAt||''}|${student.id||student.studentNo||''}|badge-evidence-v6-discovery`;   if(studentBadgeCache.has(cacheKey))return studentBadgeCache.get(cacheKey);   const cuts=(readonlyCache?.admissionCuts||[]).filter(cut=>String(cut.discoveryUse||'Y').toUpperCase()!=='N');   const rules=(readonlyCache?.admissionMinimums||[]).filter(rule=>String(rule.discoveryStatus||'').trim()!=='사용보류');   const ruleMap=new Map();   rules.forEach(rule=>{const key=universityNameKey(rule.university);if(!key)return;if(!ruleMap.has(key))ruleMap.set(key,[]);ruleMap.get(key).push(rule);});   const evidence=[];   for(const cut of cuts){     const key=universityNameKey(cut.university);if(!key)continue;     const limit=strictAdmissionCutLimit(cut.cut);if(limit==null||base.actual9>limit)continue;     const universityRules=ruleMap.get(key)||[];     const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));     let accepted=null;     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){         accepted={rule,match,check};break;       }     }     if(accepted){       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});       continue;     }     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다.
